description:
🎮 Free Transformer Course is LIVE! Level up with quizzes, flashcards, and lessons: https://utility-transformer-academy.lovable.app/

Welcome to Utility Design Simplified, where electric utility design becomes a game you can actually win.

Whether you're a new designer, an engineer in training, or a pro brushing up, each video breaks down real-world topics into quick, clear lessons:

⚡ Single phase transformers
⚡ Pole loading
⚡ CPUC rules (GO 95 and GO 128) for California 
⚡ Standards and project basics

Then test yourself with the free courses and quizzes to lock in what you learned.

Created by a utility design professional with years of hands-on experience, this channel turns complex design concepts into skills you can use on the job.

🔔 Subscribe and hit the bell to unlock new lessons.
